whyItMatters: python server fetches assemble URLs from parts (requests.(?:get|post|put|delete)s*([^)]*(?:+|{|%s)), so untrusted input reaches internal hosts.
actions: Restrict fetch hosts with a host allowlist, blocking metadata, localhost, and private ranges.
Block file/gopher/dict schemes and re-validate redirect targets.
Re-run the scan and confirm no open fetch remains.
verification: Rescan shows no open fetch, and metadata/internal probes are refused.
